info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
listProviders returns the cloud providers an org can connect and the credential
fields each one needs.
get.description:
listProviders returns the cloud providers an org can connect and the credential
fields each one needs. Keyless providers take no stored secret.

get.summary: listAccounts returns the caller org's linked cloud accounts across every
get.description:
listAccounts returns the caller org's linked cloud accounts across every
provider — metadata only; a sealed credential never appears in a response.

post.summary:
linkAccount links a labeled cloud account: it verifies the credential LIVE,
seals it in the org's KMS namespace, then discovers the account's Kubernetes
clusters and folds each into the org's fleet.
post.description:
linkAccount links a labeled cloud account: it verifies the credential LIVE,
seals it in the org's KMS namespace, then discovers the account's Kubernetes
clusters and folds each into the org's fleet. Fail-closed — a credential that
does not verify is refused and NOTHING is stored. Org admin only.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the cloud slug from the path: digitalocean, aws, gcp or azure.

delete.summary:
unlinkAccount detaches every cluster the account folded, forgets the sealed
credential and drops the index row.
delete.description:
unlinkAccount detaches every cluster the account folded, forgets the sealed
credential and drops the index row. Idempotent — unlinking an account that is
not linked succeeds. Org admin only.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the cloud slug from the path: digitalocean, aws, gcp or azure.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Label names the account within that provider; empty means "default".

post.summary:
syncAccount re-discovers and re-folds an already linked account: kubeconfigs are
refreshed, clusters deleted upstream are detached, new ones are folded.
Idempotent.
post.description:
syncAccount re-discovers and re-folds an already linked account: kubeconfigs are
refreshed, clusters deleted upstream are detached, new ones are folded.
Idempotent. Org admin only.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the cloud slug from the path: digitalocean, aws, gcp or azure.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Label names the account within that provider; empty means "default".

accounts.description: Accounts is the index (metadata only — a credential is never in a response).

label.description: Label names the account within that provider; empty means "default".

provider.description: Provider is the cloud slug from the path: digitalocean, aws, gcp or azure.

account.description: Account is the account's non-secret index record.

clusters.description: Clusters is one row per discovered cluster: folded, or the reason it was not.

clientId.description: ClientID is the Azure AAD application. Azure only.

clientSecret.description:
ClientSecret selects the Azure service-principal flow; omitting it selects
keyless Workload Identity Federation.

credentialJson.description:
CredentialJSON is a Google credentials JSON — an external_account (keyless
Workload Identity Federation) or a service_account key. GCP only.

externalId.description: ExternalID pins the AWS role assumption to Hanzo (confused-deputy protection).

label.description: Label names this account within the provider; empty means "default".

projectIds.description: ProjectIDs bounds the GCP container.clusters.list sweep.

provider.description: Provider is the cloud slug from the path: digitalocean, aws, gcp or azure.

regions.description: Regions bounds the AWS eks:ListClusters sweep.

roleArn.description: RoleARN is the AWS role Hanzo assumes cross-account (no stored keys). AWS only.

subscriptionIds.description: SubscriptionIDs bounds the Azure managedClusters sweep.

tenantId.description: TenantID is the Azure AAD tenant. Azure only.

token.description: Token is the DigitalOcean personal access token. DigitalOcean only.

providers.description: Providers is one card per cloud venue can link, with the fields each needs.

unlinked.description: Unlinked is always true — unlinking an account that is not linked is a no-op.
